usage.title: How to Use
usage.lead: From source material to living character — three steps to bring a digital character to life.

steps.title: Trace · Extract
items: Prepare character source material: novels, scripts, animation text
Run Trace to analyze language style, personality traits, and behavior patterns
Distill into a structured character profile: SoulPod

steps.title: SoulPod · Generate
items: Lock in character boundaries, capability origins, and behavior consistency
Reusable, shareable, and continuously iterable profile

steps.title: Inhabit · Converse
items: Load SoulPod and converse in character identity
Choose Replica Mode or Companion Mode
Supports role-scene dialogue, role image generation, role voice generation

flash.title: Firmware Flashing
flash.lead: Flash Companion firmware directly to your ESP32-S3 device from the browser.
flash.unsupported: WebSerial is not supported in this browser. Please use Chrome or Edge.
flash.soulpodReady: SoulPod ready — extract it into the personas folder on the device SD card
flash.step1Desc: Connect the device and flash the Companion firmware.
flash.step2Desc: After flashing, reconnect and read the device's config page address.
flash.step3Desc: Open the device's web config page in a new tab.
flash.step4Desc: Download the character SoulPod package, extract it onto the device SD card.
flash.addressHint: Click the link to open the device config page in a new tab. If it fails, make sure the device and computer are on the same network.
flash.addressNotFound: Could not get the device address. Make sure the device has firmware flashed and is running.
flash.soulpodImportStep1: Click "Download SoulPod" on a character card to get the zip.
flash.soulpodImportStep2: Extract the zip; confirm it contains profile.json / config.json / memories / prompt etc.
flash.soulpodImportStep3: Put the extracted folder into the personas folder on the device SD card (path /sdcard/personas/<character>/).
flash.soulpodImportStep4: Re-insert the SD card and restart the device to use the character.
flash.sectionFlashDesc: Flash the Companion firmware first (one-time operation for first use).
flash.sectionDeployDesc: Get the device config page address and import character SoulPod (repeatable).
